The recorded treasury amount is 1,310,960. The strongest grounded claim is: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ADA, consisting of 1,272,777 ADA for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance & Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ADA for an Intersect Budget Administration fee.

A material weak point is that this claim remains proposer-asserted or thinly supported: The work is described as a continuity proposal for an already-proven Cardano access layer rather than a new wallet product. The blocking questions are: missing complete proposal summary; missing budget analysis; missing feasibility assessment.
